workouts.summary: Tight pocket control, quick retreat resets and hesi combos at game speed with your eyes up.

drills.name: Pocket Crossover Ladder
drills.summary: Low, quick crossovers that build speed one level at a time.
steps: Get in a low stance with your eyes on a spot on the garage or fence.
Do 10 slow crossovers, pulling the ball into your hip pocket each time.
Do 10 more at medium speed, then 10 as fast as you can control.
Rest 15 seconds and repeat the ladder.
Finish with one ladder of between-the-legs crosses.

drills.name: Retreat Dribble Resets
drills.summary: Escape pressure with two retreat dribbles, then attack again.
steps: Attack forward three hard dribbles with your right hand.
Pretend a defender cuts you off. Push back with two retreat dribbles.
Keep your body between the ball and the defender.
Cross over and attack forward again with your left hand.
Go back and forth the length of the driveway.

drills.name: Hesi-to-Behind Combos
drills.summary: Sell the hesitation, then snap a behind-the-back to change direction.
steps: Push the ball forward at 75% speed.
Hit a hesitation: slow down, lift your eyes and shoulders.
Snap the ball behind your back to the other hand.
Explode out two hard dribbles.
Do both directions, then go full game speed for the last minute.

workouts.summary: Study how guards attack in transition, use or reject ball screens, and punish closeouts.

drills.name: Film: Early Offense Lanes
drills.equipment: Game film on a phone or laptop
drills.summary: Watch how teams fill lanes and what the guard sees after a rebound.
steps: Watch 10 minutes of game film and watch transition after defensive rebounds.
Track who outlets the ball and who runs the wings.
Pause when the ball crosses half court and say who is open.
Note when the guard pushes and when they pull it out.
Write one or two takeaways in your notebook.

drills.name: Film: Reject the Screen
drills.equipment: Game film on a phone or laptop
drills.summary: Learn when the ball handler should use the screen and when to go away from it.
steps: Watch 10 minutes of game film and watch every ball screen.
Pause as the screener arrives and look at the on-ball defender's feet.
Say out loud: use it or reject it?
Play it and see what the guard chose and if it worked.
Write one or two takeaways in your notebook.

drills.name: Film: Closeout Attacks
drills.equipment: Game film on a phone or laptop
drills.summary: Read the closeout and decide shoot, drive or swing on the catch.
steps: Watch 10 minutes of game film and watch players catching on the perimeter.
Pause on the catch and look at how the defender is closing out.
Say out loud: shoot, drive or swing.
Play it and check what happened.
Write one or two takeaways in your notebook.

workouts.summary: Finish with the inside hand, create space with retreat drives, and finish around length.

drills.name: Inside-Hand Layups
drills.summary: Finish with the hand farther from the defender off both sides.
steps: Start at the right elbow. Drive with one dribble.
Finish with your left hand on the right side of the rim.
Switch to the left side and finish with your right hand.
Go 8 makes each side.

drills.name: Retreat-and-Go Drives
drills.summary: Back out of trouble, then attack the rim with a burst.
steps: Set a cone at the free throw line as a defender.
Attack the cone, then hit two retreat dribbles.
Cross over and drive past the cone.
Finish with a layup on the side you went.
Alternate sides each rep.

drills.name: Hang-Glide Reverses
drills.summary: Glide under the rim and use it to shield the finish.
steps: Drive baseline from the right wing.
Gather under control as you pass the front of the rim.
Finish a reverse layup on the far side with your outside hand.
Land on two feet, balanced.
Do 6 makes each side, then add game speed.

drills.name: Cone Shot-Blocker Finishes
drills.summary: Finish around a pretend shot-blocker with floaters and extended layups.
steps: Place two cones in the paint as shot-blockers.
Drive from the top at game speed.
Read your cone: float over the first or extend around the second.
Mix finishes each rep with both hands.
Count makes out of 10, then beat it.

workouts.summary: Clean up the release, then shoot off movement and off the dribble.

drills.name: One-Hand Release Makes
drills.summary: Groove a straight release with your shooting hand only.
steps: Stand one step from the rim, straight on.
Shoot with your shooting hand only. Guide hand behind your back.
Make 5, then take one step back.
Stop at the free throw line.

drills.name: Relocate and Catch Threes
drills.summary: Shoot, move to a new spot, and be ready on the catch.
steps: Shoot a three from the wing.
Sprint to the corner or top after the shot.
Self-pass or get the pass from your rebounder.
Catch with hands ready and feet set, then shoot.
Track makes out of 20.

drills.name: Inside-Out Dribble Pull-Ups
drills.summary: Sell the inside-out, then rise for a mid-range pull-up.
steps: Start at the wing, 3 steps beyond the elbow.
Hit an inside-out dribble to freeze the defender.
Take one hard dribble to the elbow.
Stop on balance and rise into the shot.
Go both hands, game speed for the last 2 minutes.

workouts.summary: Recover with good footwork, shadow the ball, and win closeout battles.

drills.name: Drop-Step Retreat Slides
drills.summary: Open your hips and recover without crossing your feet.
steps: Get in stance on the sideline.
Drop-step back at an angle and slide three times.
Drop-step the other way and slide three times.
Zig back to the other baseline.
Rest 20 seconds and repeat.

drills.name: Shadow the Handler
drills.summary: Stay an arm's length off a dribbler who changes speed and direction.
steps: Partner dribbles the width of the lane at half speed.
Stay in stance an arm's length away, mirroring them.
Partner changes speed. Match it without reaching.
Go 30 seconds, switch roles.
Last round at game speed.

drills.name: Closeout Choice Battles
drills.summary: Close out under control and stop whatever your partner chooses.
steps: Start under the rim with the ball. Pass to your partner on the wing.
Sprint, then chop your feet to close out with a high hand.
Partner chooses: shoot, drive left or drive right.
Contest the shot or slide to stay in front for two dribbles.
Switch roles after each rep.

workouts.summary: Short, sharp bursts of sprints, slides and full-court pushes with quick rest.

drills.name: Four-Corner Sprint-Slides
drills.summary: Sprint, slide, backpedal and slide around a square.
steps: Set 4 cones in a square about 6 steps apart.
Sprint to cone 2, slide to cone 3.
Backpedal to cone 4, slide back to cone 1.
Go 30 seconds, rest 15 seconds.
Switch direction each round.

drills.name: Ladder Dribble Sprints
drills.summary: Dribble sprints to each line and back, building distance.
steps: Start on the baseline with the ball.
Speed dribble to the free throw line and back.
Then half court and back, then far free throw line and back.
Rest 30 seconds and repeat with your weak hand.

drills.name: Contain-and-Sprint Bursts
drills.summary: Defend, then sprint back like it's a turnover.
steps: Slide the width of the lane twice in stance.
Turn and sprint to half court.
Backpedal back to the lane.
Go 30 seconds on, 20 seconds off.

drills.name: Two-Minute Push Rounds
drills.summary: Full-court pushes to layups at game pace for two minutes straight.
steps: Start under the rim. Toss the ball off the glass and grab it.
Push it full court and finish a layup.
Rebound and push back the other way.
Count layups for 2 minutes. Rest 1 minute.
Do a second round and beat your count.

beginner.summary: Simple one-hand and crossover work on the driveway, keeping your eyes up on a target the whole time.

drills.name: Hand-Switch Count Dribbles
drills.summary: Control the ball with each hand, then switch with a clean crossover.
steps: Get in an athletic stance, feet shoulder-width apart.
Dribble 20 times with your right hand at waist height.
Dribble 20 times with your left hand.
Cross it over 20 times, right to left and back.
Count each dribble out loud and repeat the set.

drills.name: Eyes-Up Target Dribbles
drills.summary: Dribble without looking down by locking your eyes on one spot.
steps: Pick a target, like a garage door handle or the rim.
Dribble with your right hand and keep your eyes on the target.
Switch to your left hand after 30 seconds.
Add crossovers and keep your eyes on the target.
If you look down, restart your count.

drills.name: Crossover Step-Throughs
drills.summary: Move forward with a low crossover and a step that follows the ball.
steps: Start at the bottom of the driveway in your stance.
Cross the ball low from right to left.
Step forward with your left foot as the ball lands.
Cross back and step with your right foot.
Walk the driveway, then jog it when it feels smooth.

beginner.summary: Two short film sessions that follow one player doing one job: the screener rolling and the corner shooter spacing.

drills.name: Film: The Screener's Roll
drills.equipment: Game film on a phone or laptop
drills.summary: Watch the player who sets the ball screen and see where they go next.
steps: Watch 10 minutes of game film and watch only the player setting ball screens.
Each time they set a screen, pause right after.
Say out loud: did they roll to the rim or pop out?
Watch if the point guard passed to them.
Write one or two takeaways in your notebook.

drills.name: Film: Corner Shooter Spacing
drills.equipment: Game film on a phone or laptop
drills.summary: Watch one player in the corner and see how they stay open for the ball handler.
steps: Watch 10 minutes of game film and pick one player standing in a corner.
Watch them when the ball is driven to the rim.
Pause and say: did they stay wide, move up, or cut?
Notice if their defender left them to help.
Write one or two takeaways in your notebook.

beginner.summary: Clean layup footwork with both hands, starting close to the rim and building to a simple drive.

drills.name: Block Spot Layups
drills.summary: Short layups from the block to groove the right hand and the left hand.
steps: Stand on the right block with the ball at your chest.
Step with your left foot and lay it off the glass with your right hand.
Get your rebound and go to the left block.
Step with your right foot and finish with your left hand.
Keep going back and forth.

drills.name: Wing Two-Step Layups
drills.summary: Use one dribble and two steps from the wing to finish on each side.
steps: Start on the right wing about 15 feet out.
Take one dribble toward the rim with your right hand.
Gather the ball, step right then left.
Finish with your right hand off the top corner of the square.
Do 5 makes, then switch to the left wing and left hand.

drills.name: Elbow Lane Drives
drills.summary: Drive from the elbow at controlled speed and finish with the outside hand.
steps: Start at the right elbow in triple threat.
Jab, then drive hard with your right hand.
Keep your dribble low and go straight at the rim.
Gather and finish with your right hand.
Do 5 makes, then go from the left elbow with your left hand.

beginner.summary: Build one good shooting motion close in, then add a catch and one dribble.

drills.name: Block-to-Block Set Shots
drills.summary: Short set shots to feel your elbow, wrist and follow-through.
steps: Start on the right block, feet square to the rim.
Ball on your shooting pocket, elbow under the ball.
Shoot with a high arc and hold your follow-through.
Get the rebound and shoot from the left block.
Take a step back after 3 makes in a row.

drills.name: Short Corner Catch Shots
drills.summary: Catch ready to shoot and square up before you let it go.
steps: Stand in the short corner, 10 feet from the rim.
Self-toss with backspin, or get a pass from your rebounder.
Catch with your knees bent and hands ready.
Turn your feet to the rim and shoot in one motion.
Switch corners after 5 makes.

drills.name: One-Dribble Wing Jumpers
drills.summary: Take one dribble into a balanced jump shot from the wing.
steps: Start on the right wing, 12 feet from the rim.
Take one hard dribble toward the middle.
Pick the ball up into your shooting pocket.
Stop on two feet and rise straight up.
Do 5 makes, then switch to the left wing.

beginner.summary: Stay low, move your feet and stay in front, with a partner on the last two drills.

drills.name: Slide-and-Touch Lines
drills.summary: Defensive slides across the lane to build a low, strong stance.
steps: Get in your stance on one lane line.
Slide to the other lane line without crossing your feet.
Touch the line with your outside hand.
Slide back and touch the other line.
Rest 15 seconds after every 30 seconds.

drills.name: Arm's-Length Guarding
drills.summary: Stay one arm away from a walking dribbler and keep your chest in front.
steps: Partner dribbles at walking speed from baseline to half court.
Stand one arm's length away in your stance.
Slide to stay in front as they change direction.
Keep your hands active but don't reach.
Switch roles at half court.

drills.name: Short Closeout Chops
drills.summary: Close out under control and stop in a stance before the shooter can drive.
steps: Start in the paint with your partner at the elbow holding the ball.
Sprint halfway, then chop your feet with short steps.
Finish with one hand high and stay balanced.
Partner takes one dribble; slide to stop it.
Do 5 reps, then switch roles.

beginner.summary: Short sprints with and without the ball to build game-speed legs.

drills.name: Free-Throw Line Shuttles
drills.summary: Quick shuttle runs between the baseline and the free-throw line.
steps: Start on the baseline.
Sprint to the free-throw line and touch it.
Sprint back and touch the baseline.
Go for 20 seconds, then rest 20 seconds.
Repeat for the full time.

drills.name: Dribble Sprint and Jog Back
drills.summary: Sprint with the ball to half court, then recover with a jog.
steps: Start on the baseline with the ball.
Speed dribble to half court with your right hand.
Jog back to the baseline.
Next rep, use your left hand.
Keep going until time is up.

drills.name: Sideline-to-Sideline Dribble Runs
drills.summary: Dribble across the court and back, changing hands at each cone.
steps: Set a cone on each sideline.
Speed dribble from one cone to the other.
Cross over to your other hand at the cone.
Dribble back to the first cone.
Run for 30 seconds, rest 15 seconds, repeat.

advanced.summary: Combo moves at full speed with your eyes up, finishing with tired-hand handles after sprints.

drills.name: Cadence Cross Series
drills.summary: Own your crossover at every speed and rhythm.
steps: Get in a low stance with your eyes on a spot on the garage door.
Do 10 slow, wide crossovers, then 10 fast, tight ones.
Switch to between-the-legs, then behind-the-back, using the same slow-fast pattern.
Change the beat every 5 dribbles: slow, slow, quick-quick.
Keep both hands working the same amount.

drills.name: Shift-Gear Combo Reps
drills.summary: Go from a walk to a burst using two-move combos.
steps: Walk the ball up the driveway with a live, low dribble.
Hit a hesi into a crossover, then burst 3 hard dribbles.
Next rep, hit an in-and-out into a behind-the-back, then burst.
Start every rep with the other hand.
For the last minute, chain three moves before the burst.

drills.name: Shot Clock Combo Bursts
drills.summary: Run nonstop combos in 24-second rounds, like you're breaking down a defender late in the clock.
steps: Set your phone timer for 24 seconds on and 6 seconds off.
During each round, chain combos nonstop: cross, between, behind, in-and-out.
Every 6 seconds, attack 2 hard dribbles forward, then retreat back.
Switch your lead hand each round.
Count out loud from 24 down so you feel the clock.

drills.name: Sprint-Stop Handle Rounds
drills.summary: Keep tight handles when your legs are gone.
steps: Speed dribble the full length of the driveway.
Hit a hard two-foot stop with the ball protected.
Hit a three-move combo right away, then retreat dribble back to the start.
Repeat without resting.
For the last minute, use your weak hand only.

advanced.summary: Go deep on game film this week: handoff reads, out-of-bounds sets, and how the point guard controls pace.

drills.name: Film: Handoff Reads
drills.equipment: Game film on a phone or laptop
drills.summary: Read dribble handoffs like the guard getting the ball.
steps: Watch 10 minutes of game film and watch every dribble handoff.
Before the handoff, pause and say how the defender plays it: over, under, or switch.
Say the best read: keep it, reject it, turn the corner, or pull up.
Also watch the big after the handoff and say if he rolls, pops, or re-screens.
Write one or two takeaways in your notebook.

drills.name: Film: Out-of-Bounds Plays
drills.equipment: Game film on a phone or laptop
drills.summary: Scout baseline and sideline inbound sets, especially late in games.
steps: Watch 10 minutes of game film and watch every out-of-bounds play.
Pause before the inbound and say the set: box, stack, line, or something else.
Say the first option, the second option, and the safety outlet.
Note how the defense switches or stays home, and if the play scored.
Write down one set you could run for your team.

drills.name: Film: Pace and Possession Control
drills.equipment: Game film on a phone or laptop
drills.summary: Study when the point guard pushes, when they pull it out, and why.
steps: Watch 10 minutes of game film, ideally late in a close game.
On every possession, note the score, the clock, and the foul situation.
Pause when the guard crosses half court and say: push, set up, or run clock.
Check if the choice fit the score and clock, and say what you would do.
Write one or two takeaways in your notebook.

advanced.summary: Finish with both hands at full speed, read the help, and keep scoring when you're tired.

drills.name: Rim Circle Touch Finishes
drills.summary: Build soft touch with both hands from every angle around the rim.
steps: Start on the right block and finish with your right hand off the glass.
Rebound, step to the next spot around the rim, and finish.
Work through baseline, block, short elbow, and middle on both sides.
Use your right hand on the right side and your left on the left.
Second lap: use the opposite hand at every spot.

drills.name: Sell-and-Go Finishes
drills.summary: Use a shot fake or jab to create the drive, then finish.
steps: Start at the wing in triple threat.
Sell a shot fake or a jab step, then attack the rim in one or two dribbles.
Finish with the outside hand, away from the imaginary defender.
Alternate wings and alternate a regular layup with a reverse.
Every rep at full game speed.

drills.name: Help Cone Finish Choices
drills.summary: Read the help defender and pick the right finish at speed.
steps: Put a cone in the lane as the help defender. Move it each round.
Drive from the top or wing at full speed.
Cone at the rim: hit a floater or a runner early.
Cone up high: go by it and finish at the rim off the glass.
Cone on your hand side: go reverse or finish with your other hand.

drills.name: Finish Ladder Sprints
drills.summary: Make finishes while tired, with the reps climbing every round.
steps: Round 1: make 1 finish from each wing, then sprint to half court and back.
Round 2: make 2 from each wing, then sprint.
Keep adding one make per wing every round until time runs out.
Mix your finishes: inside hand, reverse, two-foot power.
A miss doesn't count. Rebound and go again.

advanced.summary: Build range, shoot on the move and off combos, then make threes when you're tired.

drills.name: Ladder-Back Range Shots
drills.summary: Lock in your form while moving back toward the three-point line.
steps: Start at the block and shoot until you make one.
Take one big step back after every make.
Keep the same release and follow-through at every distance.
Once you reach the three-point line, start over at the other block.
Note where your form starts to break.

drills.name: Self-Pass Fade Threes
drills.summary: Sprint into catch-and-shoot threes off a fade cut.
steps: Spin the ball out toward the wing so it bounces once.
Sprint to the ball and catch it with your feet ready.
Shoot the three right on the catch. Next rep, fade to the corner first.
With a rebounder, they pass to you as you fade instead.
Alternate sides every two shots.

drills.name: Combo-to-Pull-Up Reps
drills.summary: Pull up on balance after a two-move combo.
steps: Start at half court and attack toward the elbow.
Hit a combo: cross into between, or in-and-out into behind.
Pull up from the elbow or the top of the arc.
Alternate going left and right.
Say your make count out loud. Aim for 60% or better.

drills.name: Tired Threes Countdown
drills.summary: Make threes after a sprint, like in the fourth quarter.
steps: Sprint to half court and back.
Shoot 2 threes from one spot.
Move through the corner, wing, and top on both sides.
Count your makes. The goal is 14 out of 20.
If you miss the goal, do it again next session with the same target.

advanced.summary: Recover fast, take away angles, and win live battles with a partner at full speed.

drills.name: Hip Flip Recovery Runs
drills.summary: Flip your hips and get back in front when the ball handler blows by.
steps: Set 4 cones in a zig-zag down the floor.
Slide hard to the first cone.
Flip your hips, sprint 3 steps to cut off the line, then drop back into stance.
Repeat at every cone, alternating directions.
Jog back to the start and go again.

drills.name: Cutoff Angle Races
drills.summary: Take the right angle to beat the driver to the spot.
steps: Put a cone on the wing as the ball and a cone at the block as the driver's target.
Start at the top. Sprint on an angle to beat the 'driver' to the block cone.
Land in stance with your chest square to the ball side.
Move the cones to new spots every rep.
Do every rep at game speed.

drills.name: Pick-Up Point Pressure
drills.summary: Pick up the ball handler early and turn them to their weak hand.
steps: Partner brings the ball up from the baseline at game speed.
Pick them up before half court with active feet.
Force a turn to their weak hand and stay a step ahead.
Make them cross half court on the sideline side.
Switch roles every 3 trips.

drills.name: Three-Dribble Paint Battles
drills.summary: Keep a live attacker out of the paint when they only get three dribbles.
steps: Partner starts with the ball on the wing. You start one arm's length away.
They get 3 dribbles to reach the paint or get a shot off.
You win the rep if you keep them out and contest without fouling.
Keep score and play to 5 wins.
Switch roles and play again.

advanced.summary: Game-speed conditioning with short rest, ending in a slide-sprint-shoot circuit.

drills.name: Perimeter Pace Laps
drills.summary: Mix movements around the floor to warm up your engine.
steps: Sprint the sidelines.
Defensive slide along the baselines.
Switch slide direction every lap.
For the last lap, backpedal one sideline and sprint the other.

drills.name: Pyramid Court Sprints
drills.summary: Climb up and back down a full-court sprint pyramid.
steps: Sprint 1 court length, then rest 10 seconds.
Do 2 lengths, then 3, then 4, resting 10 seconds after each.
Come back down: 3, 2, then 1.
Touch every line with your hand.

drills.name: Coast-to-Coast Dribble Laps
drills.summary: Keep up a steady game pace with the ball, both ways.
steps: Speed dribble full court and finish a layup.
Rebound and come straight back the other way.
Use your right hand going one way and your left hand coming back.
Count your makes. Beat your score next week.

drills.name: Slide-Sprint-Shoot Circuit
drills.summary: Defend, run and score in one chain, like a late-game possession.
steps: Slide across the lane and back 3 times.
Sprint to a ball you set on a cone at the wing.
Pick it up and shoot a jumper right away.
Sprint to the far baseline and back.
Go again with no rest until time runs out.
